name: auto_route
summary: A declarative Flutter routing package focused on generated routing, strongly-typed arguments, deep linking, route guards, nested navigation, and tab navigation.
advantages: Strongly-typed argument passing with generated routes
Built-in support for deep linking and route guards
Supports nested navigation and tab navigation
Code generation reduces manual argument extraction and route boilerplate
Can also be used without code generation when a project prefers inline named route definitions
tradeoffs: The primary generated workflow introduces a code-generation step
Generated routing adds configuration and build-system complexity compared with simple Navigator usage
It is maintained outside the Flutter team, so teams must evaluate third-party package adoption and upgrade cadence
recommendedFor: Applications that prefer generated, strongly-typed routing APIs
Applications requiring deep links or guarded routes
Applications with nested or tab-based navigation
Teams comfortable with code generation as part of the development workflow

verification.reason: Current pub.dev documentation and the official GitHub repository clearly document the generated routing model and supported scenarios.
